title: Mustard Yellow Ikat Print Cotton Tunic Top for Women – Short Kurti for Jeans
color_custom: Mustard yellow with white ikat print
description:
Sunehri means golden – a sunny mustard yellow with soft white ikat drops.

A bright mustard yellow cotton tunic printed all over in an ikat-style pattern – white and pale yellow drops with soft, feathered edges. A mandarin collar with a front slit and a short button placket with metal buttons keep it smart, and the curved hem sits neatly over jeans.

✦ The Details
• Mandarin collar with a front V-slit
• Short button placket with three metal buttons
• 3/4 sleeves
• Straight cut with a curved hem, hip length
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, light and breathable. The mustard ground hides the small marks of a busy day better than white, and the ikat-style drops keep the colour from feeling flat.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size; size up if you want it looser over a long-sleeve tee in cooler months.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans, clear heels and long oxidised earrings, as in our photos; white or black trousers for office; a white flower in your hair for a sunny day out.

✦ Why Mustard
Mustard yellow is a haldi favourite and a cheerful office colour that works with denim, white, black and olive. It warms up most skin tones.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
